root_idea.summary: The reported semantic orientation is concealment or diversion from what is sought: withholding the relevant information and substituting, obscuring, or giving something else.
root_idea.development: The evidence presents a branch involving misleading or obscuring an account and a separate branch involving restraining or turning someone aside. The root-level evidence explicitly questions the soundness of the root, so this is a reported orientation rather than a secure single historical principle.

qac_form_accounting.reason: The sole Quran-attested QAC group is displayed under its normalized Form I perfect citation form.

senses.definition: In the expression لاتَ حينَ مَناصٍ: it is not the time for escape; contextually, there is no longer an opportunity for escape.
senses.usage_conditions: A fixed Quranic construction. The grammatical analysis is disputed: the expression is variously treated as a negative particle or as related to ليس or لا, while the QAC token is tagged as an active Form I verb. These analyses are recorded as one constructional sense.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To misrepresent information: to conceal or obscure what was asked about and report, narrate, or state something different from it.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A communicative construction involving concealment, an incorrect substitute account, or obscure or enigmatic expression. The evidence does not impose a general restriction on the type of person or thing involved.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To withhold or restrain someone and turn or divert him from his course, purpose, or object.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A distinct transitive construction concerning restraint or diversion from an intended course or aim; it is not assigned to the Quranic negative construction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A named idol, paired with al-ʿUzzā, regarded by its worshippers as an object through which they sought nearness to God.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A separate definite noun or name, not the Form I verb لَاتَ and not merged with the Quranic negative construction. Its reported etymology is from الإله with phonological and morphological alteration.

lane_unit_coverage.note: Misreporting or substituting a different account is represented.
Concealing information and relating something different are represented.
Obscuring or enigmatically expressing information is included in the misreporting branch.
Restraint and turning someone aside are represented separately.
Pointer-only cross-reference; it supplies no independent definition.

cautions: The Quranic token is morphologically identified by QAC as لَاتَ, but the supplied Quran-focused discussion records competing analyses of لاتَ حينَ مَناصٍ as a negative particle or a form related to ليس or لا.
The definite noun اللَّاتُ is a distinct homographic lexical item and should not be conflated with the Quranic Form I token.
The root-level evidence questions whether لوت is a sound independent root; the root idea and non-Quranic branches are therefore reported with appropriate caution.
